items.title: Bajaj Finance shares fall 3% after Q2 results. What Jefferies, Nomura, other brokerages now expect?
items.snippet: Bajaj Finance shares dropped on Wednesday after the NBFC reported a 29% year-on-year rise in Q2FY27 net profit to Rs 6,367 crore. items.title: Global Market | Safe-haven assets under pressure: Dollar, Swiss franc, German bonds and gold in focus
items.snippet: Safe-haven demand is shifting amid AI-driven market volatility, geopolitical tensions, rising energy prices and mounting government debt. The US dollar, Swiss franc, German Bunds, short-term government bonds and gold offer potential protection, but differing risks and volatile returns highlight the challenges of safeguarding portfolios during market uncertainty.

items.title: Global Market: Japanese government bond yields fall as safe-haven demand returns
items.snippet: Japanese government bond prices rose for a third session as attractive yields and safe-haven demand boosted investor interest. Record demand at a 20-year bond auction supported the recovery, while global yields declined. Economists expect the Bank of Japan to raise interest rates to 1.50% in December, though October rates may remain unchanged.
